tables.name: Danger Level
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. What makes this place dangerous: crime, environmental hazards, or other things that could make life difficult. Relative to the campaign and the characters' level.

results.name: No Danger or Hazards
results.description: The village is a perfectly safe place to be (skip danger type table).

results.name: Low
results.description: Danger or hazards are a rarity.

results.name: Medium
results.description: Danger or hazards are not unheard of, but not everyone has experienced them.

results.name: Extreme
results.description: Danger or hazards abound. It is never safe to go anywhere alone.
